2019 Q1.gq: Our strong first quarter operational performance and the trajectory of our profit improvement initiatives have allowed us to raise full year guidance to a range of $10.50 to $11 of earnings per diluted share on a GAAP basis, an increase of $1.25 from the midpoint of our guidance issued in February, highlighting our results for the quarter on a consolidated basis.
2019 Q1.bq: The $0.80 earnings per share first quarter outperformance comprises $0.65 of favorable prior-year reserve development, which we do not forecast as a matter of practice and $0.15 of first quarter performance above our original first quarter forecast.

2020 Q1.bq: We reported earnings per diluted share for the first quarter of $2.92, with net income of $178 million and an after-tax margin of 3.9%, which slightly exceeded our expectations for the quarter.

2021 Q1.gq: So very clearly increasing our guidance to no less than $13 a share.
2021 Q1.bq: Premium revenue was $6.3 million, a 47% increase over the first quarter of 2020, reflecting increased membership in line with our expectations in both Medicaid and Medicare, and exceeding our expectations in Marketplace.

2021 Q2.gq: With the increased outlook for the net negative effect of COVID, our incremental embedded earnings power is now more at $5 above our 2021 adjusted earnings per share guidance.

2021 Q3.bq: Our Medicare results exceeded our expectations.

2025 Q3.bq: Last night, we reported adjusted earnings per share of $1.84 on $10.8 billion of premium revenue, below our expectations.

2025 Q4.gq: Second, in the items driving our lower EPS guidance, underlying performance in our Medicare business deterred by $1 per share, largely due to the MAPD product.
2025 Q4.bq: Our fourth quarter results fell well below our expectations due to continued strong trend pressure in Medicare and Marketplace; and two, retroactive items in Medicaid, which totaled $2 per share.

2026 Q1.gq: We now expect same-store membership in Medicaid to decline 6% this year, up from previous guidance of a 2% decline.

2026 Q3.gq: In summary, we are pleased with our third quarter results in this challenging environment and reaffirm full year guidance of at least $5.25 per share.
